touristAppeal.label: Worth a detour
touristAppeal.summary: Kirriemuir has solid visitor appeal as J M Barrie's birthplace and the Gateway to the Glens, with the Camera Obscura, Peter Pan and Bon Scott landmarks, local museums, viewpoints, food, parking and toilets supporting a worthwhile short visit.
